many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
for n in [3,4]:
    di,do_=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    diff=[(i,j,di[i][j],do_[i][j]) for i in range(min(len(di),len(do_))) for j in range(min(len(di[0]),len(do_[0]))) if di[i][j]!=do_[i][j]]
    print(n,'diff count',len(diff))

steps.input:
# The rule so far: for each maximal same-color DIAGONAL segment (len>=2), extend
# in the direction(s) having more free cells along the line, filling background
# until blocked by a non-bg cell or the edge. All 5 demos pass except demo5's
# "which end wins when both ends have room" — verified: demo5 picks the end
# with strictly more room. Verify once more with the "more-room" implementation.
def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    bgv=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    dirs=[(-1,-1),(1,1),(-1,1),(1,-1)]
    segs=[]
    for dr,dc in dirs:
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if g[i][j]==bgv: continue
                # walk the diagonal
                p=[]; a,b=i,j
                while 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==g[i][j]:
                    p.append((a,b)); a+=dr; b+=dc
                if len(p)>1 and p[-1]!=p[0] and all((p[k+1][0]-p[k][0],p[k+1][1]-p[k][1])== (dr,dc) for k in range(len(p)-1)):
                    segs.append(p)
    for s in segs:
        col=g[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]
        # two ray ends
        res=[]
        for end,step in [(s[-1],(1,1)),(s[0],(-1,-1))]:
            dr,dc=step
            a,b=end
            room=0
            while True:
                a+=dr;b+=dc
                if not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W): break
                if out[a][b]!=bgv: break
                room+=1
                out[a][b]=col  # tentative
            res.append((room,end,dr,dc))
        # keep only rays with strictly max room
        mx=max(r[0] for r in res)
        for room,end,dr,dc in res:
            if room==mx:
                a,b=end
                while True:
                    a+=dr;b+=dc
                    if not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W): break
                    if out[a][b]!=bgv: break
                    out[a][b]=col
    return out
for n in range(1,6):
    di,do_=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n, f(di)==do_)

    for i in range(H):

            if g[i][j]==bgv or (i,j) in seen: continue

            best=None
            for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(1,1),(-1,1),(1,-1)]:

def F(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    bgv=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; seen=set()
    for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(1,1),(-1,1),(1,-1)]:
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if g[i][j]==bgv or (i,j) in seen: continue
                col=g[i][j]
                ext=[]; a,b=i+dr,j+dc
                while 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==col: ext.append((a,b)); a+=dr;b+=dc
                if not ext: continue
                # how many to extend by: take min(room, some cap)? Try full room first

                room=0; a,b=i+dr,j+dc
                while 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==bgv: room+=1; a+=dr;b+=dc
                k=min(room,len(ext))
                a,b=i+dr,j+dc
                for _ in range(k):
                    p=ext[-1]
                    a,b=p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc
                    if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==bgv: out[a][b]=col
                seen.add((i,j))
